candidate.answerReason: Deducing equality of corresponding angles from parallel lines uses properties of parallel lines, so B is correct.

methods.label: Identify the direction of deduction
methods.explanation: To deduce an angle relationship from “two lines are parallel,” use properties of parallel lines. To deduce that two lines are parallel from an angle relationship, use criteria for parallel lines.
methods.levelReason: Distinguishing properties from criteria is an explicit Grade 7 criterion in cnm_070.
